notes: Desktop, bus-powered unit — no rack size, no separate power connector (powered entirely via the USB-C host connection). Cross-verified against three sources: PreSonus official product/spec page (presonus.com/products/revelator-io24), the official PreSonus Owner's Manual PDF (fmicassets.com .../OM_2777700302_Revelator-io24_EN.pdf, sections 2.1 Front Panel / 2.1.2 Back Panel / 9.1.10 Technical Specifications), and B&H Photo's detailed spec table (bhphotovideo.com, BH# PRRIO24), which all agree. Product is discontinued/no-longer-available per PreSonus and B&H listings, but specs are authoritative historical record. Headphone output is a 1/4\" TRS jack but unbalanced (mono-summed stereo, per B&H); listed here simply as trs-6.35 since the connector-id list has no balanced/unbalanced distinction. USB-C port carries both USB 2.0 audio/MIDI data and bus power — no separate DC/power port exists on this unit. MIDI In/Out are standard 5-pin DIN connectors (confirmed "1x DIN 5-Pin Input" / "1x DIN 5-Pin Output" on B&H spec table); PreSonus's own marketing spec page omits MIDI entirely, so that detail is corroborated only by the manual and B&H, not the top-level presonus.com marketing spec block. No grades apply to the analog XLR/TRS or MIDI-DIN ports per the grading rules.
